title: Measurement of Insulin Concentration
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v63e9gn

steps.title: Pre-culture MIN6 cells
steps.instruction: Culture MIN6 cells for 30 min in Krebs-Ringer bicarbonate HEPES (KRBH) buffer containing 2 mM glucose.

substeps.instruction: Prepare KRBH buffer consisting of 140 mM NaCl, 3.6 mM KCl, 0.5 mM NaH2PO4, 0.5 mM MgSO4, 1.5 mM CaCl2, 2 mM NaHCO3, 10 mM HEPES, and 0.1% bovine serum albumin.

steps.title: Incubate cells with experimental glucose
steps.instruction: Replace the buffer with a new KRBH buffer solution containing the relevant experimental concentration of glucose and culture the cells for 1 h.

steps.title: Collect buffer and measure insulin
steps.instruction: Collect the KRBH buffer and measure the insulin concentration.

steps.title: Normalize insulin concentration
steps.instruction: Normalize the measured insulin concentration to the total cell protein level.

substeps.instruction: Normalize results to the concentration of control samples for each independent experiment to determine the insulin secretion ratio.
